scenes.name: AIoT：ESP32 連接本地 LLM
scenes.short: 端點與主機分工 · 私有 LAN
scenes.story: 桌上語音終端以 ESP32-S3 收音、顯示與控制，透過家中 Wi-Fi 連接本地 Qwen 主機。
scenes.detail: 端點不承擔 Qwen 權重；主機計入 ASR、LLM、TTS 並存。藍牙配網與音訊傳輸分開；NX／AGX 是否足夠取決於模型、量化、context 與並發，沒有通用最低機型。

scenes.name: AIoT：ESP32 相機輕量視覺
scenes.short: 傳統 CV／小型偵測 · MCU
scenes.story: 相機端辨識色塊、偵測畫面變動，或以 ESPDet-Pico 辨識單類物件後只送出事件。
scenes.detail: ESP32-S3 走 DVP 或受限 USB UVC；P4 有 MIPI CSI／ISP 與 USB HS，但需外接無線晶片。YOLO11／YOLO26 可執行不等於 30 FPS；固定量化、輸入、資料集與 SDK 後量測。

scenes.name: AIoT：家庭互動伴侶
scenes.short: 螢幕／按鍵／感測 · 服務連接
scenes.story: 帶表情螢幕的小裝置透過按鍵說話，顯示回覆並控制家中設備；可比較 Muse 服務與自建本地主機。
scenes.detail: Muse 官方 SDK 需要 app 配對與 SDK token；支援功能依板卡。預設回覆為文字，語音播報要另接 TTS。選本地服務是自建替代方案，不代表 Muse 服務能離線部署。

models.name: ESP32 連網與裝置控制
models.detail: 端點負責配網、音訊 buffer、顯示與控制；LLM 推論屬於指定的本地或服務主機。斷線重連、API 權限、OTA 與回滾需分別驗證。

models.name: MCU 傳統 CV / ESP-DL
models.detail: 傳統 CV 可先做灰階、閾值、色塊與幀差；深度偵測需 ESP-DL 相容量化圖與 SRAM／PSRAM／Flash 分別預算。完整 YOLOv8n 需自行匯出驗證，不套用 Pico 的 FPS。

iotlocal: LAN 往返 P95、斷線重連、首音訊／完整回答、主機並存 RAM、麥克風與 AEC。
LAN round-trip P95, reconnects, first audio/full reply, concurrent host RAM, microphones and AEC.
iotcv: 相機驅動、輸入像素／類別、量化精度、完整管線 FPS、PSRAM 高水位與掉幀。
Camera driver, input pixels/classes, quantization accuracy, full-pipeline FPS, PSRAM high-water mark and frame drops.
iotcompanion: 配對、token、文字與語音功能範圍、資料去向、斷線降級、OTA 回滾與控制權限。
Pairing, token, text/voice scope, data destination, offline fallback, OTA rollback and command permissions.

iotlink: 固定韌體、服務協定、音訊 codec、API schema 與重連語意；Muse 查核 ESP-IDF 6.0.1 與板卡功能表。
Pin firmware, protocol, audio codec, API schema and reconnect semantics; check Muse ESP-IDF 6.0.1 and board features.
mcuvision: 檢查 ESP-DL 量化算子、靜態 shape、Resize／Conv／decode、NMS 或端到端輸出；Pico、YOLO11、YOLO26 不共用效能保證。
Inspect ESP-DL quantized operators, static shapes, Resize/Conv/decode and NMS or end-to-end outputs; Pico, YOLO11 and YOLO26 have distinct performance.

iotlocal: An ESP32-S3 voice terminal captures audio, displays replies and controls devices through a local Qwen server on the home LAN. Qwen weights reside on the host. Budget concurrent ASR, LLM and TTS there. Separate BLE provisioning from audio transport; NX/AGX suitability depends on model, precision, context and concurrency.
iotcv: The camera node segments colors, detects changes or uses ESPDet-Pico for single-class detection and sends compact events. S3 uses DVP or bandwidth-limited USB UVC. P4 adds MIPI CSI/ISP and USB HS, with a separate wireless chip. Running YOLO11/YOLO26 does not imply 30 FPS; pin quantization, input, dataset and SDK.
iotcompanion: A small expressive display gadget accepts push-to-talk input, shows replies and controls home devices; compare Muse service with a self-hosted local backend. Muse requires app pairing and an SDK token; board features vary. Default replies are text; spoken output needs an added TTS integration. The local backend is a custom alternative, not an offline Muse deployment.
iotlink: The endpoint handles provisioning, audio buffers, display and control. LLM inference belongs to the chosen local or service host. Test reconnects, API permissions, OTA and rollback.
mcuvision: Start with grayscale, thresholds, color blobs or frame differences. Neural detection needs an ESP-DL-compatible quantized graph and separate SRAM, PSRAM and flash budgets. Custom YOLOv8n exports do not inherit Pico FPS.
